Requirement:
The system shall maintain employee information:
-Home base location
-Qualifications and endorsements: (B737NG, MAX, BCF, Q400, B787)
-Seniority ranking (it is not determined by the employee ID  number; for example, if a tech rep leaves and comes back, the seniority is not honoured, but the employee ID is reactivated) 
-Training records
-Vacation balances
-Stat holiday balances
-Sick leave balances
Acceptance Criteria and/or notes: Users should be able to generate a baseline annual schedule with minimal manual intervention

Requirement:
The system shall generate schedules for an entire year
and create assignments based on:
-Qualifications
-Home base
-Available manpower
-Maintenance workload
-Approved vacations (no more than 3 reps can be off in the same week) - Vacation assignment is based on bidding, and it is determined between (october/november) of the previous year   
-Stat holidays
-Training requirements

The system shall track 

-Mandatory recurrent training
-Endorsement certification training
-Monitor training expiry dates
-Automatically identify employees due for training
-Prevent schedule assignments that conflict with mandatory training
Acceptance Criteria and/or notes:
-Training department can submit training dates electronically
- Scheduler can approve or reject training dates
- Approved training automatically updates schedules

Requirement:
The system shall:

-Import annual vacation bids
-Apply vacation awards according to seniority
-Enforce vacation allotment limits
-Automatically block approved vacation periods
-Display remaining vacation balance
-Display available vacation capacity by period

The system shall:

-Identify overtime opportunities
-Determine eligible employees
-Validate (Required qualifications, Rest requirements, Availability)
-Support overtime distribution according to CBA rules
-Rank qualified employees by seniority where applicable

The system shall automatically validate:

- Minimum rest requirements (2 days between shifts )
-7-on / 7-off schedule compliance
-Training compliance
-Vacation limits
-Sick leave availability (Sick days will be reduced during the year; for example, in January you will have 12 days sick VS October 4 days sick for the rest of the year)
-Qualification requirements
-Seniority requirements where applicable
Acceptance Criteria and/or notes: The system shall alert users when violations occur.

Requirement:
The system shall integrate with:

- Heavy Maintenance Schedule
- Aircraft inductions
- Aircraft RTS 

The system shall:

-Recommend staffing requirements per maintenance event
-Flag staffing gaps
-Adjust schedules when aircraft dates change8 including support and  end of shift when the aircraft RTS
Acceptance Criteria and/or notes: Pull information from the HMS to assign tech reps

Requirement:
The solution shall support unplanned events such as:

-AOGs
-Lease returns
-Hard landings
-Hail damage programs
-Additional MRO support requirements

The system shall identify available qualified resources and recommend reassignment options.
Acceptance Criteria and/or notes: Pull information from the HMS to make changes for unplanned events

Requirement:
The system shall:

-Minimize unnecessary movement between MROs
-Prioritize continuity of Tech Reps at the same MRO when possible
-Consider historical assignments when generating schedules
Acceptance Criteria and/or notes: Assign consistency tech reps per location

Requirement:
The system shall notify users (leaders) when:

-Coverage gaps exist
-No qualified resource is available
-Training is due
-Vacation and sick days  limits are exceeded
-Aircraft delivery dates conflict with staffing
-Resource shortages are anticipated

The solution shall provide:

- Workforce Dashboard for managers, team members and other users to see (Available resources, Assigned resources) 

-Training Dashboard for only the manager and team members to see (Upcoming expiries, Certification status)

-Vacation Dashboard for managers, team members and other users to see (Scheduled vacation). Only manager and personal view (Remaining balances)

- Coverage Dashboard for managers, team members and other users to see (MRO staffing levels, Future staffing gaps)
Acceptance Criteria and/or notes: Have a visual dashboard and  level for data viewers
Allow owner to modify manually if any chnages are required
